name: Speed Cursor (Dynamic Size, Fire Halo, Comet & Click Ripple)
description: Never lose your mouse pointer again! Smoothly enlarges the cursor when moving (and scales it bigger with speed) with a springy, living feel, a breathing Fire Halo with a swirling flame corona, a realistic Comet-Fire trail with flying ember sparks, and an On-Click Ripple for screen recordings. Display-synced, event-driven and idle-free. Includes 5 flame color themes, button-coded click rings, Quick Settings toggles, and full customization.
